metadata.source: Synthetic advisory policy for demonstration only; not a real employer policy or approval system.

zh-TW: 需要評估時程時，詢問會議地點與時間。
任何購買前，建議查閱實際公司的差旅規範與核准管道。
未實作公司核准、支出上限、訂位權限或報銷資格。
en-US: Ask for meeting location and times when needed to assess schedule fit.
Suggest checking the employer's real travel policy and approval channel before any purchase.
No company approval, spending limit, booking authority, or reimbursement entitlement is implemented.
